reasons: Cited Sections 28.1 and 28.2 apply New York law and grant exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, matching the GOVLAW preferred position exactly.
No arbitration provision is present, so there is no foreign-seat walk-away concern; deterministic check confirms the jurisdiction is within the accepted set.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was rendered and no counterparty comment was added; the injunctive-relief carve-out and mutual escalation are correctly noted as balanced sub-elements rather than deviations.
